name: Dock Optimizer
description:
Dock Optimizer is the operations platform 3PLs, warehouses and shippers use to run their docks: appointment scheduling, driver check-in, door management, inventory, and freight.

This connector gives Claude read access to your organization's live operation — 59 resources covering the dock schedule (appointments with check-in state, door status and availability, slot capacity), inventory to the transaction (stock levels, receives and pulls with lot numbers, reservations against sales orders, storage locations, kitting recipes, cycle counts), freight (loads, bids, sales and purchase orders, carrier performance, lane analytics), and partner views (what you store for customers, and what partners hold for you).

Ask questions like: When is my dock busiest, by weekday and hour? Which inbound appointments tomorrow are missing a PO number? How much stock do we hold for this customer, and how much is reserved? Which carriers no-show most at our facilities?

Access is scoped to one organization and read-only. An Admin or Manager at your org approves the connection on a consent screen that states exactly what the token can read; the audience is resolved server-side, so no request can reach another organization's data. Every call is audited and visible to your admins in Integration Hub → Agent Keys, tokens expire hourly and renew via rotating refresh tokens, and access can be revoked at any time.

Requires a Dock Optimizer organization with an Integration Hub subscription. Setup and details: dockoptimizer.com/mcp

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dock Optimizer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dock Optimizer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dockoptimizer.com/api/mcp/v1/message. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dock Optimizer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dock Optimizer provides these MCP tools: list_resources and read_resource.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dock Optimizer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dock Optimizer in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Dock Optimizer MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dock Optimizer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dock Optimizer is developed by Conmitto. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
